description: Invite a NEW BeautyOS member by email. Read members and the staff catalog first. For own-schedule use role=staff and select staffId; only native BeautyOS permits explicit createStaff=true to create an employee with default working hours. External CRM employees must already exist. Existing members require update, restore or resend, never another invitation. Requires members.manage and beautyos.members.write. Returns a saved change ID with exact recipient, role, calendar and email effects. No access changes or email before confirmation. Show the effects and call beautyos_apply_change only after explicit approval. Ownership changes and self-role changes are forbidden; external CRM/legacy permissions are unchanged. If a receipt reports accessSaved=true and deliveryError, tell the user the invitation email failed and propose a new confirmed resend; replaying the original operation never resends.
name: beautyos_member_invite_prepare
title: Invite team member
